justifications.reason: These files are current architecture-bearing integration surfaces for the SPH/MLS-MPM resident chain, render-field ABI, browser demo mount, and long-running project evidence logs. They are allowed to remain large only while the GPU-resident hot-loop, reaction, and material closure contracts are still being stabilized.
justifications.mitigation: New behavior should move into focused runtime modules, kernels, or tests when practical. Split these files behind existing public APIs as the WebGPU marching-cubes, closure graph, reaction, and material resolver boundaries stabilize.
